# `team.repo.remove`

Revoke a team repository grant

Session-only, organization owners. Rejected for all-scope teams.

- Method and path: `POST /{org}/-/teams/{team}/repos/{repo}/remove`
- Scope: `repo:write`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie team repo remove`
- MCP: `team_repo_remove`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |
| `org` | path | yes | `string` |
| `repo` | path | yes | `string` |
| `team` | path | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`conflict`, `forbidden`, `not-found`, `unauthorized`, plus the framework problems.
